tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the SupplyClub catalog of eco-friendly foodservice packaging and supplies. Returns matching products with pricing, case configuration, and eco attributes, plus facets listing valid brand/material/category filter values for refinement.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for a single SupplyClub product by its URL slug (the last path segment of a product URL, e.g. 'paper-cups-8oz-white-1000-case'), including case facts and related_products: the matching lids, bases, and accessories for that item.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The catalog taxonomy: every category with its level (parent, primary, sub), product count, and storefront URL. The `category` filter of search_products accepts only PRIMARY-level names; parent and sub levels are for navigation and their `url`. `search_filter_value` is the exact value the `category`
